title: Names called twice in the New Testament: Martha, Simon, Saul
summary: Three New Testament passages in which a name is repeated: the Lord says 'Martha, Martha' (Luke 10:41), 'Simon, Simon' about Satan sifting him like wheat (Luke 22:31), and a voice says 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?' (Acts 9:4). The repeated names are colour-coded.

text.text: But the Lord answered and said to her, "Martha, Martha,
you are worried and bothered about so many things;—Luke 10:41
"Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has demanded permission to sift you like wheat;
and he fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him,
"Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?"—Acts 9:4
